description: I’m Mansoor, a senior Android developer at PITB in Pakistan with an M.Phil in CS. I build mobile apps in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose and like putting AI models on phones. I’ve built and mentored at hackathons, so I’ll help get a working demo done and help anyone who’s new. Pak Angels is looking for a data/GIS person (NASA Earthdata), a UI/UX designer, a backend developer, and someone who can handle the story and demo video. Beginners welcome. Message me with what you’re good at.
